items.title: Louis Keppard Interview, 1961-01-19
items.q: Well one fella could get along with him and that would make him be his best friend, Manny Monero.

ctx.x: Yeah. You see? Just too busy running around. That's right. Right. That's right. Some people talk like you, you talk like you started hard to get along with, because he was your brother, but do you think other people got along with him fast? They always liked him. They were like you said, they were funny.

Well I'll tell you, people got along with Freddie if they could drink. Yeah. And if they drink whiskey, then good whiskey. But if they never had, if they never drank whiskey they couldn't get along with him. Well one fella could get along with him and that would make him be his best friend, Manny Monero. Now I can tell you he drinks no. That's swelling taking place. Now of course they tell me he don't drink much.
